title: bootstrap.sh is broken on Linux with GCC 6 (for example, on Debian 9)

labels.name: category:vcpkg-bug
labels.description: The issue is with the vcpkg system (including helper scripts in `scripts/cmake/`)

labels.name: requires:tool-release
labels.description: An issue that has been fixed in the microsoft/vcpkg-tool repo and is waiting for a release thereof
